# ORM lacks representation for generated search vector

A generated tsvector search_vector column is added via raw SQL in the migration and has no ORM mapping in this schema. ORM-based code may be unaware of or unable to reference the generated column without separate configuration, risking mismatches between application code and database capabilities.
